lambda_x0.33.interpretation: Maximum zero-rate change versus the selected curve is 1.54bp (mean 0.32bp, forward up to 15.63bp): moderate (within the bid/ask scale). In-sample RMSE over usable instruments under this condition: 2.53bp.

penalty_power_0.condition: Refit with the maturity-weight exponent of the roughness penalty set to 0 instead of the CV-selected 1 (same lambda).
penalty_power_0.interpretation: Maximum zero-rate change versus the selected curve is 0.66bp (mean 0.27bp, forward up to 20.15bp): negligible (below typical quote noise). In-sample RMSE over usable instruments under this condition: 2.58bp.

stub_rule_round.condition: Rebuild every OIS/bond schedule with the 'round' stub rule instead of 'forward' and refit (same lambda).

In-sample RMSE over usable instruments under this condition: 2.83bp. The public conventions do not pin the payment dates or stub accrual of non-integer tenors; this reading is reported as an alternative interpretation, not as an error of the data.

rates_only.condition: Refit using deposits and OIS only; bonds are then priced off the rates-only curve.
rates_only.interpretation: Maximum zero-rate change versus the selected curve is 1.12bp (mean 0.34bp, forward up to 12.92bp): moderate (within the bid/ask scale).

uniform_weights.condition: Refit with every quote given the same base scale (spread and liquidity information ignored; robust reweighting still active).
uniform_weights.interpretation: Maximum zero-rate change versus the selected curve is 0.33bp (mean 0.13bp, forward up to 8.69bp): negligible (below typical quote noise). In-sample RMSE over usable instruments under this condition: 1.42bp.

quote_shift_+1bp.condition: Shift every market quote by +1bp (bond prices by minus one basis point of yield) and refit; a well-behaved estimator moves the zero curve by about +1bp everywhere.
quote_shift_+1bp.interpretation: A +1bp parallel shift of every quote moves zero rates by 0.988bp on average (range 0.976 to 0.999bp); the maximum deviation from the expected 1bp is 0.024bp, so the estimator passes level shifts through linearly.

jackknife_tenor_clusters.condition: Leave one tenor cluster out at a time (robust weights fixed) and measure the largest change in the zero curve; large values flag tenors that single-handedly shape the curve.
jackknife_tenor_clusters.interpretation: Deleting one tenor cluster at a time changes the zero curve by at most 3.33bp; the most influential cluster is the 30.00y cluster. Influence is concentrated where the curve is least covered.

quote_noise_bootstrap.condition: 20 seeded replications adding Gaussian noise of one estimated noise scale to every quote (robust weights fixed); reports the standard deviation of the fitted zero curve.
quote_noise_bootstrap.interpretation: Across 20 bid/ask-scaled noise replications the zero-rate standard deviation is at most 1.10bp (median 0.33bp): quote noise of the observed size does not destabilise the curve.
